claims.text: In the classic game the 1987 blackout leaves the harbor district dark for three days.
The Saltworks Syndicate controls the harbor's night shipping.
The blackout gave the Syndicate cover to move shipments unseen.
Some players believe the Syndicate staged the blackout itself.
The remake may revisit the blackout from the Syndicate's side.
